data.name: The Clownhouse
data.detailed_description:
The Clownhouse

Break into a cursed mansion.

Steal everything you can.

Escape before the Clown finds you.

Do it alone, or with up to 3 friends in online co-op.

The Clownhouse is a stealth horror extraction roguelite where every run is a gamble. Loot valuables, manage your sanity, and decide how long you're willing to stay before greed gets you killed.

The mansion changes every run. Layouts shift, dangers move, and the deeper you go, the worse things become. Most runs don't last long, but every escape makes the next one easier.

There are no weapons here. You survive by staying quiet, hiding in the dark, disguising yourself, improvising tools, and knowing when it's time to leave.

Survive Together — Co-op for Up to 4 Players

Break in alone, or bring up to three friends into the mansion with you.

  • Online co-op for up to 4 players. The mansion is hard enough alone — facing it together changes everything.

  • Split up to grab more loot faster, or stick close when the Clown starts hunting.

  • Coordinate distractions, barricade doors, and cover each other's escape.

  • More players means more loot to carry out — and more ways for a run to fall apart.

  • Prefer a lonelier nightmare? Every run can still be played solo.

Greed Keeps You Inside

Every run is a risk-reward gamble.

  • Search the mansion for cash, jewels, rare valuables, and hidden rooms.

  • Manage limited inventory space and weight. Every item you carry could mean leaving something better behind.

  • Escape with what you've found, or push deeper and risk losing everything.

  • Short, high-tension runs built for replayability.

The Mansion Wants You Gone

You're not alone inside.

  • The Clown stalks the halls relentlessly. Sometimes it kills. Sometimes it just watches and laughs while your sanity collapses.

  • The Butcher only hunts in the light. In darkness, he's harmless. Sometimes your flashlight is the most dangerous thing you own.

  • The Rabbit lurks through the mansion wearing a mask you'll desperately want for yourself.

Outsmart Them

You can't fight what hunts you. You survive by tricking it.

  • Wear disguises. Steal the Bunny Mask and walk among the mansion's horrors unnoticed.

  • Stay hidden. Turn off your flashlight, crouch through darkness, and avoid making noise.

  • Slow them down. Barricade doors, deploy distractions, and use crafted tools to buy yourself precious seconds when escape is the only option.

  • Move quietly. Find gear that muffles your footsteps and keeps attention away from you.

Hold Onto Your Mind

The longer you stay, the harder it becomes to think clearly.

  • Sanity constantly drains inside the mansion, especially when the Clown decides to toy with you.

  • Craft cocktails from looted alcohol to steady your nerves and survive longer runs.

  • Solve puzzles and unlock sealed rooms hiding the mansion's most valuable rewards.

Key Features

  • Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

  • Stealth horror extraction gameplay.

  • Fast, replayable roguelite runs.

  • Procedurally generated mansion layouts.

  • Risk-reward looting and extraction loop.

  • No combat. Only stealth, hiding, and survival.

  • Build barricades, deploy distractions, and improvise survival tools.

  • Unique enemies with different behaviors and weaknesses.

  • Disguise system that lets you blend in with the mansion's horrors.

  • Sanity system affected by darkness and enemy encounters.

  • Inventory management with limited space and weight.

  • Hidden rooms, puzzles, and rare valuables.

  • Persistent roguelite progression between runs.

Early Access

The Clownhouse is in active development, and now playable in solo and online co-op for up to 4 players. Early Access lets you experience the core extraction-horror loop now while new enemies, mechanics, areas, progression systems, and content continue to be added and refined over time.

data.short_description: Solo or co-op for up to 4 players: break into a cursed, procedurally generated mansion, steal everything you can, and escape before the horrors inside find you. A no-combat stealth horror extraction roguelite where greed kills more players than enemies do.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280 (2 GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 4000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS / SteamOS 3.0+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 4000 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280 (Vulkan required)
  • Sound Card: PulseAudio compatible
  • Additional Notes: Vulkan support required. Steam Deck compatible.
